entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A former planeswalker from Eldraine specializing in electrical magic, twin sister of High King Will Kenrith, who lost her spark in the Great Pruning.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Rowan's twin brother and High King, who uses ice magic and shared a single spark with her.

entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: The twins' father, abducted by Oko and Garruk, killed by the Wild Hunt and restored by Linden.

entities.name: Linden
entities.description: The twins' stepmother, who gave up her sword's power to restore their lives and restored Algenus.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch and Rowan's aunt who teaches her sleep magic and works with Ashiok.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: A witch, Rowan's aunt.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A witch, Rowan's aunt.

entities.name: Erec
entities.description: Rowan's sibling.

entities.name: Hazel
entities.description: Rowan's sibling.

entities.name: Royse
entities.description: A spiderlike fae weaver implied to be Rowan's lover, who helps her seek a cure for the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker who with Garruk abducted High King Algenus.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker cured of the Chain Veil curse who promises to protect the twins.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: Invited the twins to join Strixhaven as students.

entities.name: Professor Onyx
entities.description: A Strixhaven professor, actually the planeswalker Liliana Vess, who saved the twins from an Oriq attack.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: The Oriq leader who bound himself to a Snarl and was killed by the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who greets Rowan at Castle Ardenvale and is defeated by Will.

entities.name: Imodane
entities.description: A combatant who fought Will in single combat.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A friend who helped Will defeat Ashiok.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: A friend who helped Will defeat Ashiok.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: A summoned war entity that killed Extus Narr and gravely wounded Will.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A faction that attacked Strixhaven with mage hunters.

entities.name: Wild Hunt
entities.description: The hunters who killed the stag form of High King Algenus.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The twins' home plane.

entities.name: Kylem
entities.description: The plane where the twins competed at Valor's Reach.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven where the twins studied.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university the twins attended and defended.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: The castle where the twins' parents died defending it and where Rowan meets Ashiok.

entities.name: Stormcutter Mountain
entities.description: A mountain named after the rift Rowan cut into it.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A curse that seized the people of Eldraine after the Invasion.

entities.name: Great Pruning
entities.description: The event through which Rowan and Will lost their shared spark.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which the twins' parents were killed.

events.summary: Rowan and Will are born to a witch who kills the newborns for their blood; Linden gives up her sword's power to restore them and adopts them.
events.quote: their adoptive mother gave up her sword's power to restore life to the twins and took them in as her children

events.summary: The twins quest for their father, abducted by Oko and Garruk and transformed into a stag.
events.quote: he has been transformed into a stag

events.summary: The Wild Hunt kills the stag, and Linden restores Algenus with his Questing Sword.
events.quote: bringing Algenus back to life by using his Questing Sword

events.summary: Learning the truth about their origins ignites the twins' spark and they planeswalk away.
events.quote: The shock ignites the twins' planeswalker's spark and they disappear.

events.summary: The twins compete as champions of Valor's Reach on Kylem.
events.quote: The twins were champions of Valor's Reach .

events.summary: Kasmina invites the twins to Strixhaven, where Rowan struggles and the twins quarrel until Professor Onyx stops them and tasks them with preparing a defense against the Oriq.
events.quote: The siblings were invited to join Strixhaven as students by Kasmina .

events.summary: Rowan and Will face Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar beneath the Biblioplex and join powers so Will wrests control of the Avatar, which kills Extus but gravely wounds Will.
events.quote: The Avatar killed the Oriq leader and was sent back from where it came, but not before gravely wounding Will.

events.summary: The twins' parents are killed by the invaders while defending Castle Ardenvale.
events.quote: Rowan and Will's parents were killed by the invaders while defending Castle Ardenvale .

events.summary: After the Invasion the twins unknowingly lose their shared spark as the Wicked Slumber seizes Eldraine.
events.quote: the twins unknowingly lost their shared spark

events.summary: During Will's duel with Imodane, Rowan cuts a rift into a mountain, naming Stormcutter Mountain.
events.quote: Rowan cut a massive rift into a nearby mountain

events.summary: Ashiok and Eriette tell Rowan of her lost spark and family tie; she joins her aunt, and fights Will, who defeats Ashiok and captures Eriette while Rowan escapes.
events.quote: Will was able to defeat Ashiok with the help of Kellan and Ruby
